posts.title: Zero Parades: For Dead Spies
posts.description: Zero Parades, like Disco Elysium, feels like a genuinely creative endeavour. It's written by novelists and poets and its visually identity is forged in the spirit of fine art. Inasmuch as its predecessor is worth mentioning, its sordid corporate drama becoming more and more tiresome as the days go by, it is as a creative reference point. And in that sense Zero Parades honours this creative legacy.
